security_spec.violation_condition: When mseccfg.MMAP=1 and an M-mode load/store/instruction-fetch targets a physical address that has no matching PMP entry, the XiangShan PMP checker must deny the access. If the RTL instead grants access (default M-mode permissive behavior without checking mseccfg.MMAP), the hardware permits M-mode to bypass all Smepmp protections by targeting regions deliberately left without PMP rules — the very attack vector Smepmp was designed to close.
security_spec.summary: MMAP=1 must deny M-mode accesses to PMP-unmatched regions; failing to gate M-mode default-allow with MMAP creates a trivial Smepmp bypass via intentionally uncovered address ranges.
